title: Lightspeed leads Anthropic's $3.5B Series E

sources.quote: Anthropic has raised $3.5 billion at a $61.5 billion post-money valuation.

The round was led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, with participation from Bessemer Venture Partners, Cisco Investments, D1 Capital Partners, Fidelity Management & Research Company, General Catalyst, Jane Street, Menlo Ventures and Salesforce Ventures, among other new and existing investors.

explain: Lightspeed led a $3.5 billion funding round for Anthropic at a $61.5 billion valuation. The amount shown is the whole round; Lightspeed's own share was not disclosed.
